decision.explanation: The question asks when 'Attorney General Russell' was called to the Bar. Two distinct but related answers appear in the original sources: D1S4 states he was called to the Bar in 1859, while D2S4 specifies January 1859. These are not contradictory but complementary, providing both a year and a month. The other candidates (1845 and 1861) refer to different individuals named Russell in the documents and are not relevant to 'Attorney General Russell'.
